title: AMD Interns
description: The ECE Association, College of Engineering Trivandrum, congratulates Achutha Aswin Naick, Meriya Eleyas, Karthik A K, and Shradha P (ECE'27) on securing Physical Design Intern positions with the Cores Team at AMD. Their internships are scheduled to commence on 3 August 2026. We wish them a successful and enriching internship experience and all the very best for their future endeavors.
